translations.idiomatic: The emperor still favored him; Zhu Ergeng'e alone was punished to quiet critics.

sentences.zh: 十八年，命協辦大學士，總督如故。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was made Associate Grand Secretary while retaining the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he became associate grand secretary while remaining governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十九年，初彭齡奉命赴江蘇同查虧帑，議不合。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Chu Pengling was ordered to Jiangsu to investigate treasury deficits together with him; they did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Chu Pengling came to Jiangsu to audit treasury deficits with him and they clashed.

sentences.zh: 彭齡為所掣，恚甚，遂劾百齡受鹽場稅關餽遺，按之未得實，彭齡坐誣被譴。

translations.literal: Pengling was obstructed by him, was greatly angered, and impeached Bai Ling for receiving gifts from salt fields and tax gates; investigation did not prove it, and Pengling was punished for false accusation.
translations.idiomatic: Chu, thwarted, impeached Bai Ling for salt and customs bribes; the charge failed and Chu was punished for slander.

sentences.zh: 會鹽運使廖寅捕逆犯劉第五，部鞫為偽。

translations.literal: At the same time Salt Transport Commissioner Liao Yin captured the rebel Liu Diwu; the ministry trial found it false.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile salt commissioner Liao Yin arrested rebel Liu Diwu, but the ministry found the case false.

sentences.zh: 百齡亦坐失入，褫宮銜，罷協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Bai Ling was also punished for wrongful conviction, stripped of palace rank, and removed as associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling was faulted for the false arrest, stripped of palace rank, and removed as associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 江南莠民散佈逆詞，連及百齡，嚴詔責捕。

translations.literal: Wicked men in Jiangnan spread seditious writings implicating Bai Ling; a stern edict ordered capture.
translations.idiomatic: Seditious tracts in Jiangnan implicated him; a stern edict ordered arrests.

sentences.zh: 二十年，獲首、從方榮陞等百五十人，並抵法，复宮銜，封三等男爵，兼署安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the leaders and followers Fang Rongsheng and more than 150 others were captured and punished by law; his palace rank was restored, he was enfeoffed as third-class baron, and concurrently acted as Governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year 150 rebels including Fang Rongsheng were executed; his rank was restored, he was made third-class baron, and acted as Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，病甚，命松筠往代，卒於江寧。

translations.literal: That winter he fell gravely ill; Songyun was ordered to replace him, and he died at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, gravely ill, he was replaced by Songyun and died at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 帝聞，悼惜，詔复協辦大學士，遣侍衛賜奠，許柩入城治喪。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard, he mourned and regretted; an edict restored him as associate grand secretary, sent a bodyguard with libations, and permitted the coffin to enter the city for funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned him, restored his associate grand secretary rank, sent libations, and allowed his coffin into the city.

sentences.zh: 將遣皇子奠醊，既而以江北災民未能撫卹，停其奠醊，仍賜祭葬如例，諡文敏。

translations.literal: He was about to send a prince to offer sacrifice, but then because disaster refugees in north Jiang had not been properly relieved, the prince's sacrifice was stopped; funeral honors were still granted as usual, posthumous name Wenmin.
translations.idiomatic: A prince's sacrifice was planned but canceled because north Jiang refugees were unrestored; standard funeral honors remained, with posthumous name Wenmin.

sentences.zh: 子扎拉芬，襲男爵。

translations.literal: His son Zhala Fen inherited the barony.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhala Fen inherited the barony.

sentences.zh: 伯麟，字玉亭，瑚錫哈哩氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Bo Lin, courtesy name Yuting, of the Husihali clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Lin, courtesy name Yuting, of the Husihali clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由繙譯舉人授兵部筆​​帖式，擢右春坊右贊善，累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: From a translator licentiate he was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of War, was promoted to Right Tutor of the Eastern Palace, and successively rose to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: From translator licentiate to war ministry clerk, he rose to right palace tutor and grand secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十七年，授盛京兵部侍郎，尋授山西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year of Qianlong he was appointed Vice Minister of War at Mukden, and soon Governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 57 he became Mukden vice minister of war, then governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶九年，擢雲貴總督。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Jiaqing he was promoted to Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 9 he became governor-general of Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十年，緬甸與暹羅屬夷戛於臘構釁，求助於孟連土司刀派功，往援遇害，失其印。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Burma and the Siamese subject state Gayaunla provoked trouble; they sought help from Menglian native official Dao Paigong, who went to aid and was killed, losing his seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Burma and Siamese Gayaunla clashed; Menglian chief Dao Paigong died aiding them and lost his seal.

sentences.zh: 伯麟以刀派功禍由自取，惟責暹羅繳所得印。

translations.literal: Bo Lin held that Dao Paigong had brought trouble on himself and only required Siam to return the captured seal.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Lin blamed Dao Paigong and demanded only that Siam return the seal.

sentences.zh: 十一年，緬甸請預期納貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Burma requested to pay tribute ahead of schedule.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Burma asked to pay tribute early.

sentences.zh: 伯麟知其與暹羅構兵，為求助地，卻之。

translations.literal: Bo Lin knew they were at war with Siam and sought help; he refused.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing Burma fought Siam for aid, he refused.

sentences.zh: 後緬甸為戛於臘所敗，果來乞援，伯麟拒勿應，戛於臘旋亦敗走。

translations.literal: Later Burma was defeated by Gayaunla and did come begging aid; Bo Lin refused to respond, and Gayaunla soon was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When defeated Burma begged for help, Bo Lin refused; Gayaunla was soon beaten off.

sentences.zh: 緬兵次車里土司界，嚴兵守邊，移檄訓戒，緬兵遂退。

translations.literal: Burmese troops reached the Cheli native office border; he stationed troops strictly on the frontier, sent a dispatch of admonition, and the Burmese withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Burmese troops neared Cheli; he reinforced the border, sent a warning dispatch, and they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 迤南江外倮匪入邊劫掠，遣普洱鎮總兵那林泰剿平之。

translations.literal: Luo bandits south of the river beyond the frontier raided the border; he sent Pu'er garrison commander Na Lintai to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Luo raiders crossed the frontier; Pu'er commander Na Lintai suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 十三年，緬甸四大萬頭目來請十三板納地，伯麟責其冒昧，諭以十三板納為九龍江土司所轄，俱屬內地，毋生覬覦，詔嘉其得體。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Burma's four great chiefs came requesting the thirteen-ban territory; Bo Lin rebuked their presumption and instructed that the thirteen bans were under the Jiulong River native office, all inner territory, and they must not covet them; an edict praised his propriety.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Burmese chiefs sought thirteen-ban land; Bo Lin rebuked them and affirmed it as inner territory under Jiulong River; the throne praised his tact.

sentences.zh: 十四年，入覲，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he entered audience and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he attended court and received the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 十七年，騰越邊外野寨頭目拉幹出擾，遣兵擒之。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the wild stockade chief Lagan beyond Tengyue border raided; he sent troops who captured him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year border chief Lagan raided; troops captured him.

sentences.zh: 緬寧、騰越要隘舊設土練一千六百名，久廢，規復其制，給曠土耕種。

translations.literal: At Tengyue and Mianning key passes the old native militia of 1,600 had long been abandoned; he restored the system and granted wasteland for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: He restored 1,600 abandoned native militia at Tengyue and Mianning and granted land for farming.

sentences.zh: 僧銅金從倮夷李文明為亂，已悔罪投誠，更姓名為張輔國，充南興土目；

translations.literal: The monk Tongjin had followed the Luo rebel Li Wenming in revolt, had repented and submitted, changed his name to Zhang Fuguo, and served as Nanxing native officer;
translations.idiomatic: Monk Tongjin had followed Li Wenming, repented, renamed himself Zhang Fuguo, and became Nanxing native officer;

sentences.zh: 至是復勾結倮眾侵擾，伯麟赴緬寧督土司會剿。

translations.literal: at this time he again colluded with Luo people to harass; Bo Lin went to Mianning to direct the native offices in joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: he then rallied Luo raiders again; Bo Lin led native offices against him from Mianning.

sentences.zh: 十八年正月，進逼南興，破其巢，輔國就戮，邊境肅清。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year he pressed Nanxing, stormed their lair, Fuguo was executed, and the border was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, first month, he stormed Nanxing, executed Fuguo, and pacified the border.

sentences.zh: 增設騰越鎮馬鹿塘、大壩二汛。

translations.literal: He added garrisons at Malutang and Daba of Tengyue command.
translations.idiomatic: He added garrisons at Malutang and Daba under Tengyue command.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，臨安邊外夷人高羅衣自稱窩泥王，偽署官職，糾眾萬餘，攻殺土目龍定國，擾瓦渣、溪處兩土司境，渡江窺伺內地，伯麟親往剿平之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year beyond Lin'an border the Yi Gao Luoyi styled himself King of Woni, falsely appointed officials, gathered more than ten thousand, killed native officer Long Dingguo, disturbed the Wazha and Xichu native offices, crossed the river to spy on inner territory; Bo Lin went in person to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Yi leader Gao Luoyi beyond Lin'an styled himself king, mustered ten thousand men, killed native officers, and threatened inner territory; Bo Lin suppressed him in person.

sentences.zh: 議定善後條規，使各土司綏靖夷民，以安反側。

translations.literal: He set follow-up regulations so each native office might soothe the Yi people and secure those inclined to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: He enacted regulations so native offices could pacify the Yi and secure wavering groups.

sentences.zh: 敘功，加太子少保。

translations.literal: For merit he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was made junior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋命協辦大學士，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to serve as Associate Grand Secretary while retaining the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made associate grand secretary while remaining governor-general.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，羅衣從侄高老五竄藤條江外復為亂，擾及郡城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Luoyi's nephew Gao Laowu fled beyond Tengtiao River and rebelled again, disturbing even the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Gao Laowu rebelled again beyond Tengtiao River and threatened the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 督師剿擒之，餘黨悉殲。

translations.literal: He directed the army to suppress and capture him; the remnant party was entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: He crushed and captured him and destroyed the remnants.

sentences.zh: 增設臨安江內東、西兩路要隘塘汛官兵，以江外煙瘴最盛，降夷就撫，裁撤留防兵練。

translations.literal: He added garrison troops at key posts on the east and west routes within Lin'an River, and because miasma was worst beyond the river, as surrendered Yi were pacified he cut the retained defensive militia.
translations.idiomatic: He garrisoned Lin'an's east and west routes and, as surrendered Yi were pacified beyond the malarial river, reduced retained militia.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，召授兵部尚書，兼都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was summoned and appointed Minister of War, concurrently a banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was recalled as minister of war with a concurrent banner command.

sentences.zh: 复疏陳滇、黔邊務六事，如議行。

translations.literal: Again he memorialized six matters on Yunnan-Guizhou border affairs, and they were implemented as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized six border policies for Yunnan-Guizhou, all adopted.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，拜體仁閣大學士，管理兵部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Entirety and managed the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 he became grand secretary of the Hall of Entirety and managed the war ministry.

sentences.zh: 尋以年老休致，仍充實錄館總裁。

translations.literal: Soon, on account of age, he retired but still served as chief compiler of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He soon retired for age but remained veritable records chief compiler.

sentences.zh: 三年，萬壽節，與十五老臣宴。

translations.literal: In the third year, on the longevity festival, he dined with the fifteen elder ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the fifteen elders at the longevity feast.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒，諡文慎。

translations.literal: After more than a year he died, posthumous name Wenshen.
translations.idiomatic: He died the following year with posthumous name Wenshen.

sentences.zh: 伯麟任邊圻凡十六年，廉潔愛民，士林尤感戴之。

translations.literal: Bo Lin held the frontier post for sixteen years, was incorrupt and loved the people, and the scholarly class especially cherished him.
translations.idiomatic: For sixteen years on the frontier Bo Lin was honest and beloved; scholars especially revered him.

sentences.zh: 還朝後，以旗人生計為憂，疏陳調劑事宜，深中利弊。

translations.literal: After returning to court, concerned for bannermen's livelihood, he memorialized adjustment measures that hit the crux of advantage and harm.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital he memorialized on banner livelihood with keen insight into real interests.

sentences.zh: 論者謂有名臣風。

translations.literal: Commentators say he had the bearing of a famous minister.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators called him a minister of renown.

sentences.zh: 論曰：仁宗倚畀疆臣，膺重寄者，多參揆席。

translations.literal: The critique says: The Renzong Emperor relied on frontier ministers, and those who bore heavy trust often sat in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The critique says: Emperor Renzong trusted frontier governors, and many who bore heavy responsibility joined the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 書麟、吉慶並勤勞軍事，而盡瘁辱身，有幸不幸焉。

translations.literal: Shu Lin and Jiqing both labored diligently in military affairs yet exhausted themselves in disgrace; each had fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Lin and Jiqing both toiled in war yet died in disgrace—each knew fortune and misfortune.

sentences.zh: 長麟、費淳先後治吳，一嚴一寬，才德互有優絀。

translations.literal: Zhanglin and Fei Chun governed Wu in succession, one strict and one lenient; in talent and virtue each had strengths and weaknesses.
translations.idiomatic: Zhanglin and Fei Chun governed Jiangsu in turn, one strict and one mild, each with distinct gifts.

sentences.zh: 百齡號能臣之冠，機牙鋒銳，凌轢一時，晚節乃招物議。

translations.literal: Bai Ling was called the crown of capable ministers, sharp and aggressive, dominating his age, yet in his later years drew public criticism.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling was hailed the foremost capable minister—clever and domineering—yet his late years drew criticism.

sentences.zh: 如伯麟之安邊坐鎮，遺愛不湮，識量豈易及哉？

translations.literal: As for Bo Lin's calm frontier rule and enduring goodwill, can such breadth of judgment be easily matched?
translations.idiomatic: Bo Lin's steady frontier rule and lasting goodwill—who easily matched his judgment?
